# Complete and harden the S3 bucket Admin REST contract

- **Kind**: feature
- **Date**: 2026-08-06
- **Requested by**: Ian Starnes
- **Depends on / unblocks**: portal-mojo #1298 “Admin: Storage”
- **Apply rules**: `django-mojo-build-conventions`, `nativemojo-board-conventions`

## Description

Make the existing S3 bucket REST surface honest and sufficient for the global Storage Admin: propagate AWS failures, support public/private transitions, and provide a version-aware, server-confirmed empty operation. Bucket deletion remains unsupported.

## Context

`/api/aws/s3/bucket` currently lists and creates only. Existing helpers for access/empty are not dispatched, and `S3.list_all_buckets()` converts AWS/IAM failures into `[]`, which falsely tells operators the account has no buckets.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `GET /api/aws/s3/bucket` preserves its current success envelope but returns a failed HTTP envelope for AWS/IAM/network failures instead of an empty list.
- [ ] Idempotent `POST /api/aws/s3/bucket/<name>` creation remains supported and returns a normal record envelope.
- [ ] `POST .../<name>` with `{set_public:true|false}` invokes the existing helper and returns `{name,is_public}`; helper failure must reject.
- [ ] `POST .../<name>` with `{empty:{confirm_name:"<name>"}}` rejects absent/mismatched confirmation.
- [ ] Empty success removes current objects, all versions/delete markers, and outstanding multipart uploads, returning bounded deletion/abort counts.
- [ ] Partial AWS failure rejects with the bucket name and never fabricates completion counts.
- [ ] Bucket DELETE stays unsupported and is covered by tests/docs.
- [ ] Add focused tests for success/failure envelopes, exact-name confirmation, versioned cleanup, multipart cleanup, and partial failures.

## Investigation

- **What exists**: `mojo/apps/aws/rest/s3.py`, `mojo/helpers/aws/s3.py`, and helper methods used by the legacy UI.
- **What changes**: REST dispatch, honest error propagation, version-aware empty helper behavior, tests, and docs.
- **Constraints**: no migration; destructive operation must be server-confirmed; do not add bucket deletion.
- **Related files**: `mojo/apps/aws/rest/s3.py`, `mojo/helpers/aws/s3.py`, focused AWS REST/helper tests.
- **Out of scope**: frontend UI, bucket deletion, uploads, and provider credential management.
